DIAGNOSIS READY: Congestive Heart Failure secondary to an Atrial Septal Defect.

The BNP was not available, and despite the liver ultrasound showing normal readings, the physical exam findings of rapid breathing, pitting edema, and significant liver enlargement (hepatomegaly), combined with your confirmed atrial septal defect, are classic signs of right-sided heart failure due to pulmonary over-circulation. This explains your symptoms despite the normal liver function tests.
